instruction: Open VLC and begin streaming from this URL: https://demo.unified-streaming.com/k8s/features/stable/video/tears-of-steel/tears-of-steel.mp4/.m3u8

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires streaming a variant of Tears of Steel demo stream in VLC. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric. Same difficulty level.
metadata.verification_notes: Reuses existing VLC evaluator functions. Another variant of the Tears of Steel test stream.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: VLC is playing AND the correct URL is being streamed
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly fetches VLC status via HTTP interface and returns status.xml path

Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly parses XML, checks playing state, and performs robust URL matching with multiple fallback methods (direct match, filename match for HLS streams, domain/path comparison)
Expected parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns rules dict directly, metric accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'] appropriately
Complete instruction coverage: verifies both 'Open VLC' (playing state) and 'streaming from URL' (URL match)
Good edge case handling: multiple URL matching strategies, HLS stream support, logging for debugging
Practical and feasible: VLC HTTP interface provides reliable access to playback state and URL information
